page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g5ne.8xlarge is a general-purpose virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features an x86_64 architecture with 32 dedicated physical cores using the Intel Xeon 8163 processor running at 2.5 GHz. The instance is configured with 128.0 GB of system memory, providing 4.0 GB of RAM per core. It does not include any local storage or GPU hardware, relying entirely on network-attached storage. Baseline network bandwidth is rated at 15 Gbps.

Performance benchmarks indicate a clear distinction between single-core and multi-core capabilities. Single-core performance is relatively weak, as shown by stress-ng and Geekbench single-core tests falling into the bottom 25%, and single-threaded gzip compression scoring in the bottom 10%. However, multi-core execution scales effectively, achieving average tier results in multi-threaded stress-ng, Passmark CPU, and bzip3 decompression tests. Memory bandwidth for both small and large blocks remains in the average range, though the Passmark memory score is positioned in the bottom 25%.

Given the dedicated 32-core configuration and balanced 1:4 memory-to-vCPU ratio, this instance offers stable multi-threaded processing capabilities. It is suitable for workloads such as static web serving, database operations, and software compilation, which all registered average performance in benchmark testing. The lack of local storage and weak single-core performance are key tradeoffs, suggesting it is best utilized for distributed, multi-threaded applications rather than single-threaded or storage-heavy tasks.
